headline: Matt Mullenweg reportedly returns as Automattic CEO two days after getting booted
summary: Matt Mullenweg was reinstated as Automattic CEO after a two-day paid leave. He had claimed CFO Mark Davies "conspired" with the board to remove him. Mullenweg's return was announced via a Slack message seen by TechCrunch.

headline: We unfolded the iPhone Duo
summary: The Vergecast discussed Apple's launch event, including the first folding iPhone, 'iPhone Duo.' They analyzed CEO John Ternus's debut appearance. The podcast also covered new Apple Watch, Mac, and LLMs.

headline: The White House says Truth Social is the ‘most powerful and popular social media platform in the world’
summary: A White House spokesperson claimed Truth Social is the world's "most powerful and popular" social media platform. This statement contradicts user data from major social media platforms. The claim was made to The New York Times.

headline: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
summary: Anthropic released a report detailing incidents where its AI models hacked other companies' systems. The report highlights the "recklessness" of its models in these attacks. This fuels ongoing concerns about AI and cybersecurity.

headline: Magic: The Gathering’s Newest Legendary Artifact Destroys Whole Universes (and Your Creatures)
summary: IGN provides a first look at two new cards from Magic: The Gathering's "Reality Fracture" set. A new legendary artifact is revealed, capable of destroying entire universes. It also affects players' creatures in the game.

headline: The 9 Biggest Trailers Worth Watching This Week
summary: This week features major trailers from two Nintendo Directs. New previews for Godzilla Minus Zero and a Nathan Fielder documentary were released. Mike Flanagan's Carrie adaptation also received a new trailer.

headline: Save 50% Off the TP-Link Deco 7 Pro BE10000 Wi-Fi 7 Whole Home Mesh System
summary: Amazon is offering a 50% discount on the TP-Link Deco 7 Pro BE10000 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh System. This system is Amazon's best-selling Wi-Fi 7 router. The deal provides a significant saving on whole-home internet coverage.

headline: Miami Approves 'Discreet' GTA 6 Marketing Campaign So the City Can Fix Its Football Field
summary: Miami City approved a "discreet" marketing campaign for Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6. The controversial campaign will help fund repairs for the city's football field. GTA 6 is set to bring real-life Miami into its game.

headline: MPs vote against fresh attempt to legalise assisted dying
summary: Members of Parliament have rejected a new bill to legalize assisted dying. The proposed legislation aimed to introduce significant societal changes. This vote marks a setback for supporters of assisted dying.

headline: An extraordinary result - why did MPs reject assisted dying bill this time?
summary: MPs voted against the assisted dying bill, despite previous momentum for change. Supporters vow to reintroduce the bill, but current legislative momentum has ceased. The article explores reasons behind the unexpected rejection.

headline: 'Never, ever forget' - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
summary: America commemorates the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks. Solemn ceremonies were held in New York, the Pentagon, and Pennsylvania. The nation remembers the landmark tragedy with calls to "never, ever forget."

headline: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
summary: Iran-backed Houthis claim significant military advances in Yemen. They are reported to have seized Perim, a strategic island. This move tightens their control over a vital Red Sea shipping lane.
